Alert.Headline: State/Lake Elevated Station Temporary Closure

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
How does this affect my trip?
Effective, Monday, January 5, 2026, the State/Lake Loop Elevated station will temporarily close.

Please use the accessible Clark/Lake or Washington/Wabash stations, located within a few blocks of the State/Lake station. To transfer between the Red Line at Lake station and the Loop ‘L’ lines, use Washington/Wabash.

Why is service being changed?
The new State/Lake elevated station is scheduled to open in 2029. It will replace one of the oldest stations on the CTA rail system with a modern facility designed to improve safety, accessibility, and comfort for all riders.

Alert.Headline: New, Modern Clark/Lake Station Thompson Center Entrance Opens
Alert.ShortDescription: 4am, Mon, Nov 23 - NEW station entrance to Clark/Lake opens. Old entrance south side of Lake St under 'L' tracks, mid-block btw Clark and LaSalle, will close.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
Effective 4am, Mon, Nov 23

The NEW, modernized and fully accessible entrance to Clark/Lake will open to riders Monday morning. The new entrance is part of the historic redevelopment of the Thompson Center.

The new Thompson Center entrance is located on the southwest corner of Clark and Lake streets (194 N Clark); the old entrance on the south side of Lake Street under the elevated tracks, mid-block between Clark and LaSalle streets, will close as construction work continues.

The new Clark/Lake station entrance includes these features:

• Fare vending machines

• New lighting

• ADA accessible fare gate

• New real-time alerts, elevator status and system status screens

• New signage

• Security cameras

Riders will see continued construction work both outside the building and past the station’s paid area as the redevelopment of the Thompson Center proceeds.
